Use case: identity-preserve. Production PIXEL ART whole-figure walk sheet for existing native64 square-grid roguelike.
Input1=EXACT identity/proportions/palette master. Input2=accepted MOVEMENT guide only: do NOT copy its body, face, species, colors or clothing. Input3, when present,=existing rear APPEARANCE only, not gait.
Draw EXACTLY 3 equal columns x3 equal rows. First8 cells are 8 DISTINCT ordered phases of TWO short alternating steps:1left contact,2settleleft,3right passes LOW UNDER hips,4rightreaches,5rightcontact,6settleright,7leftpasses LOW,8leftreaches toloop. Ninth relaxed idle. 400ms/step,800ms cycle. Compact planted supports, restrained body bob; constant camera, scale, head/body construction and proportions. Arms remain hanging arms, never weight-bearing legs. No splaying, high knees, jumping, running, skating or whole-body zoom.
Draw every whole coherent figure with connected head/torso/hips/knees/feet; no detached head, leg graft or pixel-band shift. Preserve natural original body breadth and leg length. Slight elevated front game camera with parallel square-grid axes, NOT side-view/isometric diamond.
Match muted matte pixel-art material values, deep original shadows, crisp readable pixel clusters at native game size. NO whitening, added light, rim highlight, gloss, glow, 3D, smooth HD painting, blur or grain. Colored fringe specks in references are export artifacts, NOT emissive details or anatomy.
All figures complete with generous transparent cell margins, no clipping or overlap. GENUINE alpha ZERO background and limb gaps. NO floor, shadow, matte, checkerboard, labels, text, border or grid.
Exact silhouette at game size: 61px WIDE by60px HIGH. Retain this whole-figure WIDTH/HEIGHT RATIO 1.016 in every pose; don't make it narrower or longer-legged. Draw within a roughly330px-high silhouette in each equal square cell with the corresponding width.
SUBJECT: Lean dark MAROON red biped, LOW deeply hunched torso, TWO short bent walking legs and TWO enormously long forearms ending in pale ivory hooked claw fingers. Preserve the large curved pale/red bony crown crest, low small recessed face SEPARATE BELOW the crest, segmented cream bony ribs over shoulders/sternum and back. Original compact body is approximately square overall; no tall torso, no lengthened legs, no thickened human thighs. Crown crest is NOT the nose, tail, extra arm or second head. Keep ivory warm/cream, flesh deep maroon, dark hollows. No armor, weapon, clothing, wings, new horns, tail or extra limbs.
DIRECTION: All first8 FRONT/slight front-three-quarter walking DOWN toward viewer, retaining the master's recognizable head angle, torso and chest markings. Form real compact steps below the original torso, without making the creature stand more upright.
